worldcombat.skill.chipaway.summary: Strike repeatedly at close range, ignoring the target’s stat-stage changes.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.use.0: A point-blank combo whose beats land at different heights
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.use.1: Ignore the target's raised Defence stages outright
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.use.2: Grind health down with a fast, cheap combo
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.description.0: Each beat deals about %1$s contact damage; %2$s beats, each settled on its own. The target's Defence stages are ignored by this move.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.rush.on: Rush form: one extra beat, shorter wind-up and cooldown and slightly less reach, but each beat is lighter; good for quick pressure and interrupts.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.rush.off: Steady form: the same number of beats but each is heavier, with a longer wind-up and cooldown; good for grinding down high-health or slow starters.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.growth.0: At level %1$s each beat rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.growth.1: At level %1$s each beat rises to %2$s and the combo to %3$s beats.
worldcombat.skill.chipaway.preference.ru: On (rush): one extra beat, wind-up -2 ticks, cooldown -3 ticks, reach x0.95, but each beat x0.8. Off (steady): the same beats at x1.12 each, with a longer wind-up and cooldown. Each direction has its moment: rush presses denser and cycles faster, steady hits harder per beat.
